name: PhD in Neuroscience and Neurotechnology
detailsNote: Official information available. The Fall 2027 deadline comes from the application portal entry for the Psychological and Brain Sciences pathway; other pathways were not checked separately. Whether students apply to a lab or a program is not stated, so no admission model is shown. Letters of recommendation are not stated.
summary: Georgia Tech PhD in neuroscience and neurotechnology. Applicants choose an admissions pathway (Biological Sciences, Psychology or Biomedical Engineering) matching their first-choice advisor's school.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: Portal lists Fall 2027 as December 1, 2026; all deadlines are 11:59 PM Eastern Time.

english.toefl: 100 (iBT, minimum score of 19 for each section)
english.note: IELTS 7.5 with at least 6.5 in listening, reading and speaking and 5.5 in writing (program page). Georgia Tech's general minimums are lower: TOEFL 4.5 (new scale), IELTS 7.0.

applicationFee.note: Georgia Tech waivers recognize outstanding undergraduate achievement and recruitment events; international applicants must complete all application materials before requesting one. Fee: $95 domestic, $105 international.

documents: Four-year US bachelor's degree or equivalent

funding.note: Full-time PhD students receive a tuition waiver and monthly stipend through graduate assistantships. Rotations are not required for students who establish an advisor when entering.
